description: Flat metadata schema for a clinical registry capturing patient characteristics, prior treatments, radiotherapy planning and delivery, acute toxicity, and outcomes for breast cancer patients undergoing radiotherapy.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the registry record or patient-treatment case.

patient_id.descr: De-identified patient identifier used to link multiple records belonging to the same patient.

age_at_diagnosis_years.descr: Age in years at breast cancer diagnosis or at radiotherapy start if diagnosis date is unavailable.

sex.descr: Biological sex or sex assigned at birth; expected values such as female, male, intersex, unknown.

race_ethnicity.descr: Self-reported or recorded race/ethnicity category using the registry's controlled vocabulary.

body_mass_index_kg_m2.descr: Body mass index in kg/m^2 measured closest to radiotherapy initiation.

menopausal_status.descr: Menopausal status at baseline; expected values such as premenopausal, perimenopausal, postmenopausal, unknown.

performance_status.descr: Baseline functional status score, for example ECOG or Karnofsky as used by the registry.

diagnosis_date.descr: Date of initial breast cancer diagnosis.

cancer_laterality.descr: Side of the primary breast cancer; expected values such as left, right, bilateral, unknown.

histology_type.descr: Tumor histology, for example invasive ductal carcinoma, invasive lobular carcinoma, DCIS, or other.

tumor_grade.descr: Pathologic tumor grade, typically 1, 2, 3, or unknown.

stage_at_diagnosis.descr: Clinical or pathological stage at diagnosis, using TNM-derived stage or another registry-defined staging system.

estrogen_receptor_status.descr: Estrogen receptor status; expected values such as positive, negative, equivocal, unknown.

progesterone_receptor_status.descr: Progesterone receptor status; expected values such as positive, negative, equivocal, unknown.

her2_status.descr: HER2 status; expected values such as positive, negative, equivocal, unknown.

ki67_percent.descr: Ki-67 proliferation index expressed as percent of tumor cells stained positive, if available.

genetic_marker_name.descr: Name of the genetic marker or mutation assayed, such as BRCA1, BRCA2, PALB2, or a panel name.

genetic_marker_result.descr: Result for the specified genetic marker; expected values such as positive, negative, variant_of_uncertain_significance, not_tested.

previous_surgery.descr: Whether the patient had breast or related cancer surgery before radiotherapy.

previous_chemotherapy.descr: Whether the patient received chemotherapy before radiotherapy.

previous_hormone_therapy.descr: Whether the patient received endocrine or hormone therapy before radiotherapy.

previous_immunotherapy.descr: Whether the patient received immunotherapy before radiotherapy.

previous_radiotherapy.descr: Whether the patient previously received radiotherapy before the current course.

prior_treatment_summary.descr: Free-text or coded summary of prior cancer treatments, including agents, surgery type, dates, and response if relevant.

comorbidity_index.descr: Baseline comorbidity score, such as Charlson Comorbidity Index, if collected.

smoking_status.descr: Smoking status at baseline; expected values such as never, former, current, unknown.

radiotherapy_intent.descr: Clinical intent of radiotherapy; expected values such as curative, adjuvant, neoadjuvant, palliative, salvage.

radiotherapy_modality.descr: Primary radiation modality or technique used, for example photons, electrons, protons, brachytherapy, IMRT, VMAT, 3D-CRT.

radiation_type.descr: Type of radiation used, for example external beam, brachytherapy, intraoperative, or mixed.

total_prescribed_dose_gy.descr: Total prescribed dose in Gray (Gy) for the radiotherapy course.

number_of_fractions.descr: Total number of planned fractions in the radiotherapy course.

treatment_duration_days.descr: Planned treatment duration in days from first to last fraction.

planning_target_volume_cc.descr: Planning target volume in cubic centimeters, if available.

planning_date.descr: Date the radiotherapy plan was finalized or approved.

start_date.descr: Date of first radiotherapy treatment fraction.

end_date.descr: Date of last radiotherapy treatment fraction.

treatment_site.descr: Anatomical treatment site, for example whole breast, chest wall, regional nodes, boost volume.

fractionation_scheme.descr: Fractionation schedule description, for example conventional, hypofractionated, ultra-hypofractionated, boost sequence.

planning_system_name.descr: Name of the treatment planning system used, if recorded.

prescribed_isodose_percent.descr: Percent isodose level used for prescription, if applicable.

session_number.descr: Sequential number of the treatment session or fraction within the course.

session_date.descr: Date on which the treatment session was delivered.

delivered_dose_gy.descr: Actual dose delivered in Gray (Gy) for the session, if session-level recording is available.

deviation_from_plan.descr: Whether the delivered session deviated from the planned protocol.

deviation_type.descr: Category of deviation such as missed fraction, dose adjustment, interruption, setup correction, or machine downtime.

deviation_description.descr: Narrative description of the deviation from the planned radiotherapy protocol.

acutely_toxicity_present.descr: Whether any acute side effects were observed during or shortly after treatment.

acute_toxicity_type.descr: Primary acute toxicity type, for example dermatitis, fatigue, esophagitis, pneumonitis, pain, edema.

acute_toxicity_grade.descr: Severity grade of the acute toxicity, for example CTCAE grade 1 to 5.

acute_toxicity_onset_date.descr: Date acute side effects were first documented.

acute_toxicity_resolution_date.descr: Date acute side effects resolved or returned to baseline, if known.

hospitalization_due_to_toxicity.descr: Whether toxicity required hospitalization or urgent medical intervention.

treatment_completion_status.descr: Whether the prescribed radiotherapy course was completed as planned; expected values such as completed, discontinued, modified, unknown.

recurrence_present.descr: Whether disease recurrence was documented during follow-up.

recurrence_date.descr: Date of first documented disease recurrence, if applicable.

recurrence_site.descr: Anatomical site of recurrence, for example local, regional, distant metastasis, contralateral breast.

disease_free_survival_months.descr: Disease-free survival time in months from radiotherapy start or end, according to registry convention.

overall_survival_months.descr: Overall survival time in months from diagnosis or radiotherapy start, according to registry convention.

recovery_status.descr: Post-treatment recovery outcome, for example fully recovered, partially recovered, not recovered, unknown.

quality_of_life_score.descr: Patient-reported quality-of-life score collected at follow-up, if available, using the registry-defined instrument.

follow_up_date.descr: Date of the most recent follow-up assessment.
